summary: A 45-year-old U.S. citizen living in Paris fell while scrambling about 1,000 feet above Lake Haiyaha and had his leg pinned by a boulder; two partners could not free him; teams evacuated him by inflatable raft across the lake and wheeled litter to the trailhead, then by ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center
location: Above Lake Haiyaha, Bear Lake corridor, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS rangers, Larimer County Search and Rescue, Rocky Mountain Rescue
notes: Fall occurred Monday; rescue completed Tuesday afternoon with ~30 personnel NPS RMNP release (Aug 16, 2016): 45-yo U.S. citizen living in Paris; fell ~1,000 ft above Lake Haiyaha, leg pinned by boulder; ranger stayed overnight; low-angle scree evacuation, inflatable raft across lake, wheeled litter; reached trailhead ~3:30 p.m.; Estes Park Medical Center; Larimer County SAR + Rocky Mountain Rescue, 30 personnel. Primary-source upgrade from the syndicated beaconjournal URL.
